name: Airborne
help: Well trained Paratroopers can destroy Enemy positions with Satchel Charges, and can be equipped with M18 Recoilless Rifles for addition protection against all Vehicle types.

name: Engineers
help: Call in Engineers to construct and Repair Structures. Engineers can be equipped with Minesweepers, Flamethrowers, Wire Cutters and Demolition Charges.

name: Heavy Machine Gun Team
help: Utilizes a .30 cal M1917 Heavy Machine Gun to lay down an enormous amount of firepower that is especially effective against massed Infantry. armor piercing bullets are effective against Light Vehicles.
extra: Good vs. Infantry and Light Vehicles

name: Mortar Team
help: The M2 60mm Mortar can drop Mortar Bombs on concentrations of Infantry, Heavy Weapons, or Squads in Buildings. Use this weapon to break through defensive impasses.
extra: Good vs. Infantry, Infantry in cover

name: Rangers
help: Elite assault Troops equipped with Thompson SMGs and M9 Bazooka's. Excels in all combat situations. Can be equipped with Grenades.

name: Riflemen
help: Versatile soldier in attack or defense. Grenades, Sticky Bombs and M1918 BARs provide protection against multiple threat types.

name: Sniper
help: Highly skilled Sharpshooter with scoped M1903 Rifle, effective against all Infantry. Can use camouflage ability.

name: Eselschreck
help: Equipped with Dual-Panzerschrecks for the rider and Two Stuka launchers strapped directly to the Donkey itself the Eselschreck is... explosive.

name: Jeep
help: The Jeep's speed makes it an ideal Reconnaissance unit that excels at hunting down Enemy Snipers.

name: M10 Tank Destroyer
help: The M10 sacrifices armor protection for a heavier main Gun. The M10 relies on its powerful 3 inch main Gun and its speed to tackle Enemy Tanks.

name: M18 Hellcat
help: The M18 Hellcat is a tank destroyer that comes equipped with .50 cal machine gun and the ability camouflage.  It has a reduced frontal armor penetration capabilities.

name: M1 57mm Anti Tank Gun
help: The M1 57mm Anti Tank Gun offered reasonable protection against Enemy Tanks, but could also tackle hardened Structures. APC Shells improve armor penetration.

name: M1 57mm Anti Tank Gun
help: The M1 57mm Anti Tank Gun offered reasonable protection against Enemy Tanks, but could also tackle hardened Structures. APC Shells improve armor penetration.

name: M26 Pershing
help: This late war Tank matched a Heavy 90mm gun with much stronger armor to produce an Allied Tank that could engage Enemy Panthers and Tigers

name: M2 105mm Howitzer
help: The M2 105mm Howitzer provides long range indirect fire support

name: M3 Halftrack
help: Transport and Reinforce Troops, or equip the Halftrack with a Quad .50 cal Turret.

name: M4 Sherman
help: The M4 Sherman is the workhorse of the Allied armies in Normandy. Upgrades to its main gun, a .50 cal Machine Gun, a Crab mine flail, and Smoke Dischargers can carry the M4 through to the end of any battle.

name: Sherman Calliope
help: Outfitted with a Calliope that is capable of a devastating Rocket Barrage.

name: M4 'Crocodile' Sherman
help: The Crocodile is an assault Tank and comes equipped with a Flamethrower but cannot fire its main Gun. Can be equipped with a Bulldozer to clear obstacles.

name: M8 Armored Car
help: Fast reconaissance Vehicle which is good at harrassing Enemy Infantry and destroying Light Vehicles. Can be equipped with better armor and an .50 HMG.

name: T17 Armored Car
help: The T17 is a heavier armored car variant tested by US forces, able to use White Phosphorus rounds against enemy targets.

name: Captain
help: The lightly-armed Captain imparts powerful defensive bonuses to units and structures within the sector that he occupies.

name: HMG Commandos
help: A Commando Section equipped with a .303 Vickers Heavy Machine Gun, effective against massed infantry.

name: Mortar Commandos
help: A Commando Section equipped with the standard British 3" Mortar.

name: PIAT Commandos
help: A Commando Section armed with PIAT Anti Tank weapons.

name: Commandos
help: British Commandos are tough, elite troops armed with light weapons and explosives.

name: Heavy Machine Gun Team
help: Utilizes a .30 cal M1917 Heavy Machine Gun to lay down an enormous amount of firepower that is especially effective against massed Infantry. Armor piercing bullets are effective against Light Vehicles.

name: Lieutenant
help: Lieutenants provide much of the offensive punch of the infantry sections, imparting powerful attack and morale bonuses in a radius. Squads are more mobile with a Lieutenant nearby.
extra: Commander. Imparts Offensive Bonuses and Mobility

name: Mortar Team
help: The M2 60mm Mortar can drop Mortar Bombs on concentrations of Infantry, Heavy Weapons, or Squads in Buildings. Use this weapon to break through defensive impasses.
extra: Good vs. Infantry, Infantry in cover

name: Sappers
help: Sappers are combat engineers capable of specialized upgrades, general combat related tasks, and building heavy defenses.
extra: Builds Heavy Defenses. Good vs. Infantry

name: Infantry Section
help: British Infantry are dogged, well-trained soldiers with a variety of versatile upgrades that enable them to tackle a variety of combat tasks.
extra: Good vs. Infantry, Light Vehicles. Constructs Defenses

name: Canadian Infantry
help: Comprised solely of volunteers, Canadian Infantry are rugged, tough, well-trained, strongly motivated, and very versatile combat units.
extra: Good vs. Infantry, Light Vehicles. Constructs Defenses

name: 25 Pounder Gun Howitzer
help: Long range, effective accuracy, and a good rate of fire are hallmarks of the 25 Pounder Artillery in use by British and Commonwealth forces.

name: Armor Command Truck
help: The Armor Command Truck coordinates and deploys Heavy Armor on the battlefield.
extra: Deploys the Cromwell Tank, Cromwell Command Tank, Staghound Armoured Car, Kangaroo Carrier, and Sherman Firefly

name: Bofors 40mm Cannon
help: The Bofors 40mm cannon is dangerous to low flying aircraft and light vehicles, but its light shell and limited depression on the gun allow heavy armor and infantry to get close.

name: Bren Carrier
help: The ubiquitous Bren Carrier can transport a section of Infantry or an officer. Can be outfitted with a Vickers MMG for added  fire support.

name: Churchill AVRE
help: The rugged Churchill provided the chassis for a variety of modifications designed to breach Normandy beach defenses. The AVRE fires a massive 290mm HESH warhead that can flatten buildings and defenses.
extra: Good vs. Buildings, Obstructions and Infantry

name: Churchill Crocodile
help: The Churchill Crocodile, along with other Churchill derivatives, was designed for the invasion of Normandy, but found wide use in all subsequent battlefields. It maintains its normal 6pounder gun and adds a fearsome flame projector.

name: Churchill Mk IV
help: The Churchill Infantry tank was heavily armored and slow; designed to move with and support infantry by knocking out pillboxes and other field fortifications.
extra: Good vs. Infantry and Light Tanks

name: Cromwell Command Tank
help: The unarmed Command Tank uses a dummy gun barrel to mask its true identity from the enemy. Massive radios crowd the turret, allowing communication with nearby tank squads and other command elements.
extra: Commander. Improves Nearby Tank Effectiveness. Unarmed

name: Cromwell
help: The Cromwell mates a 75mm main gun with reasonable armor and a powerful V12 engine. The Cromwell offers similar performance to the M4 Sherman, but is a lower profile target that is harder to hit - a fact that is of great interest to its crews.

name: 17 Pounder AT Gun
help: The 17 Pounder was possibly the most fearsome Anti Tank gun employed by any nation during WW2. The weapon was large and cumbersome, which limited its use against infantry and fast moving light vehicles.

name: Eselschreck
help: Equipped with Dual-Panzerschrecks for the rider and Two Stuka launchers strapped directly to the Donkey itself the Eselschreck is... explosive.

name: Headquarters Command Truck
help: The Headquarters Command Truck constructs basic units and creates supplied territory when it is set up.
extra: Deploys Infantry Sections, Lieutenants, and Bren Carriers.

name: Kangaroo Carrier
help: The Kangaroo Carrier is a heavy armored personnel carrier. With no standard turret the Kangaroo relies on its large hold and garrisoned squads to give it offensive value.

name: Priest Self-Propelled Artillery
help: The 105mm Howitzer-armed Priest was used by British and Commonwealth forces during and just after the Normandy Invasion. The powerful howitzer can fire a variety of artillery barrages.

name: Sherman Firefly
help: A very powerful 17 Pounder Anti Tank Gun added to a relatively standard Sherman creates the Firefly. British and Commonwealth forces can finally engage and kill heavy enemy tanks at very long ranges.

name: Field Support Truck
help: The Field Support Truck coordinates and constructs Stuart Light Tanks, Sappers, and Captains.
extra: Deploys Sappers, Captains, and Stuart Light Tanks

name: Staghound Armoured Car
help: Built by the US, the Staghound was adopted by the British as a versatile command and recon vehicle.  Can be equipped with an M2HB .50 cal Machine Gun.

name: Stuart Light Tank
help: The Stuart is used by almost all Allied forces. Too light to engage heavy armor, its speed means it excels in the reconnaissance role. Can fire a canister round that is lethal to infantry targets.

name: Tetrarch
help: The 2 Pounder equipped Tetrarch tank was designed to be glider deployed, and was therefore lightly armored. It provided much needed fire support to units operating behind enemy lines.

name: Grenadiers
help: Formed the backbone of the Axis forces. Can be equipped with MG42s and Panzerschrecks.

name: MG42 Heavy Machine Gun
help: An MG42 Heavy Machine Gun with a fire rate of 1200 rounds per minute can devastate Enemy Infantry.

name: Knight's Cross Holders
help: Elite assault Troops equipped with MP44s. Excel in all combat situations.

name: Gr. 34 8cm Mortar Team
help: The Granatewerfer 34 8cm Mortar provides indirect fire support.

name: Officer
help: Highly experienced officers who led by example fighting from the front.
extra: Can Supervise Buildings to improve production, call in Mortar fire on Enemy Units, and Rout Enemy forces.

name: Pioneers
help: Primary Builder. Can build and Repair Structures. Pioneers can be equipped with Minesweepers or Flamethrowers and can salvage destroyed Vehicles for supplies.

name: Sniper
help: Highly skilled Sharpshooter, effective against all Infantry. Can use Camouflage ability.

name: Stormtroopers
help: Elite Infantry that can be equipped with MP44 Assault Rifles. Can learn how to use Bundled Grenades.

name: Volksgrenadiers
help: Light Infantry with little combat experience.

name: 150mm Nebelwerfer Rocket Battery
help: The Nebelwerfer can launch six 150mm Rockets.
extra: Area of Effect Barrage. Good vs. Infantry

name: Pak 38 50mm Anti Tank Gun
help: Long range Anti Tank weapon with good armor penetration, but little area of effect. The Pak 38 can Camouflage to ambush Enemy Vehicles and can get several shots off before it reveals itself.
extra: Good vs. Tanks, can ambush attack.

name: 88mm Flak 36 AT/AA
help: The 88mm Flak 36 provides fearsome Anti Tank and Anti Air firepower.

name: Schwimmwagen Type 166
help: A fast reconnaissance vehicle, the Schwimmwagen Type 166 can utilize its speed to mercilessly hunt down elusive Snipers.

name: Eselschreck
help: Equipped with Dual-Panzerschrecks for the rider and Two Stuka launchers strapped directly to the Donkey itself the Eselschreck is... explosive.

name: Geschutzwagen
help: Equipped with a Pak40 75mm cannon, this highly mobile, anti-tank gun can lock-down and eliminate enemy targets at a rapid rate.

name: Goliath
help: A small remote controlled Bomb that can inflict massive area effect damage upon detonation.

name: Sdkfz 251 Halftrack
help: Can transport and Reinforce Troops in and out of battle. Can be equipped with Wurfrahmen 40 rockets ('Stuka zu Fuss') or Flamethrowers.

name: Motorcycle
help: A fast reconnaissance Motorcycle, it can utilize its speed to mercilessly hunt down elusive Snipers.

name: Ostwind Flakpanzer
help: Armed with a rapid firing 37mm Gun that can target Aircraft, Light Vehicles, and Infantry.

name: Panther
help: The Panther is one of the best Tanks in the war. Armed with a deadly 75mm main Gun and exceptional frontal armor, the Panther's only weakness is its rear and top armor.

name: Panzer IV
help: The mainstay of the Panzer divisions, the Panzer IV is capable of tackling Enemy Tanks at range. Veteran Panzers are equipped with armor skirts and a MG42.

name: Sdkfz 234 Armored Car
help: A fast-moving reconnaissance Vehicle.  Pumas are equipped with a 50mm Anti Tank Gun.

name: Stug IV
help: The Stug IV is armed with a fixed 75mm main Gun. The Stug IV is effective at supporting Infantry and ambushing Enemy Tanks.

name: StuH 42
help: The addition of a 105mm howitzer to the Stug chassis created an excellent support tank for blasting through enemy defenses.

name: King Tiger
help: In the hands of a regular crew, the Tiger is a powerful weapon. Under the command of a Tiger Ace, it's almost unstoppable.

name: Tiger
help: The most feared tank in the war, the Tiger has heavy front and rear armor and is armed with a powerful 88mm main Gun. The Tiger had few combat weaknesses.

name: Tiger
help: The most feared tank in the war, the Tiger has heavy front and rear armor and is armed with a powerful 88mm main Gun. The Tiger had few combat weaknesses.

name: Luftwaffe Squad
help: This should not be read anywhere

name: Fallschirmjager
help: Fallschirmjager infiltration squad

name: Panzer Grenadiers
help: Panzer Grenadiers are tough and versatile infantry, trained to work with support vehicles in fast, mobile attacks.

name: Panzer Grenadiers
help: Panzer Grenadiers are tough and versatile infantry, trained to work with support vehicles in fast, mobile attacks.

name: Assault Grenadier Heavy Infantry
help: These Panzer Elite Heavy Infantry are trained and equipped for Assault tactics. They come equipped with MP44 Sturmgewehr assault rifles.

name: Tank Buster Heavy Infantry
help: Tank Buster Heavy Infantry are equipped with Panzerschreck Anti Tank weapons for handling armor threats.

name: Scout Car
help: The SdKfz 221 Scout Car has great speed and mobility. Armed with an MG42 light machine gun, the Scout car can engage light targets and also capture and hold territory.
extra: Good vs. Snipers, can capture Territory

name: Armored Car
help: The Sdkfz 222 Armored Car marries high speed and all terrain mobility with a rapid firing 20mm cannon capable of destroying infantry and other soft targets.

name: Infantry Halftrack
help: The SdKfz 250 is a small, light halftrack capable of carrying squads of infantry into an attack. The Infantry Halftrack can also supply the reinforcement needs of nearby troops.
extra: Good vs. Infantry, can reinforce nearby squads

name: Mortar Halftrack
help: Mortar Halftracks mount the heavy 81mm Granatewerfer 34 in the rear of the vehicle, enabling crews to fire the mortar with good protection from small arms fire.

name: Light AT Halftrack
help: The Light AT Halftrack mounts a small, but accurate 37mm  Anti Tank gun in place of the normal machine gun. This halftrack can use its accuracy to hit infantry, and specifically target the running gear of tanks and other vehicles in order to disable them.

name: Funkwagen 'Vampire' Halftrack
help: Powerful radios equip the 250/3 Funkwagen 'Vampire' enabling it to interdict enemy signals and disrupt their supply lines. This vehicle siphons resources away from enemy sectors that it sets up in.  It has no weaponry of its own, so must be supported when in enemy territory.

name: Munitions Halftrack
help: The Munitions Halftrack is specially equipped to deliver munitions to front line units. Infantry and vehicles within the support radius of the Munitions Halftrack will rapidly recharge any abilities that make use of munitions.

name: 88mm Flak 36 AT/AA
help: The 88mm Flak 36 provides fearsome Anti Tank and Anti Air firepower.

name: Bergetiger Repair and Recovery Vehicle
help: A heavy-lift crane and reconfigured turret turn this Tiger chassis into a Bergetiger, enabling it to repair tanks and other vehicles, and recover destroyed vehicles so they can be returned to action.

name: Eselschreck
help: Equipped with Dual-Panzerschrecks for the rider and Two Stuka launchers strapped directly to the Donkey itself the Eselschreck is... explosive.

name: Goliath
help: A small remote controlled Bomb that can inflict massive area effect damage upon detonation.

name: Hetzer
help: The diminutive Hetzer mounted the same powerful Pak39 as used on the Panzer IV, but in a reliable, well-armored chassis that was also easy to conceal.

name: Hotchkiss Light Tank
help: The Hotchkiss is a lightly armored Tank with high mobility. Upgrading the Hotchkiss with a Stuka Rocket rack gives it mobile artillery capabilities.
extra: Area of Effect Barrage. Good vs. Infantry

name: Hummel Self Propelled Artillery
help: The Hummel ('Bumble Bee') is self-propelled artillery; basically a very heavy 150mm leFH18 howitzer on a heavily modified Panzer IV chassis.

name: Jagdpanther
help: The Jagdpanther is a heavy tank destroyer mating the 88mm Pak 43 from King Tiger to a turretless Panther Tank chassis.  It boasts a powerful engine giving it a good power-to-weight ratio resulting in good mobility on the battlefield.

name: Marder III Tank Hunter
help: The Marder III mounts a powerful Pak40 75mm Anti Tank gun on a 38t chassis but its drawbacks include a limited weapon traverse and poor crew protection.

name: Panther
help: The Panther is one of the best Tanks in the war. Armed with a deadly 75mm main Gun and exceptional frontal armor, the Panther's only weakness is its rear and top armor.

name: Schwimmwagen Type 128
help: The unarmed Schwimmwagen Type 128 is highly versatile with the potential to track enemy targets, scorch strategic points, or lay mines.

name: Panzer IV Infantry Support Tank
help: This Panzer IV is equipped with a short-barreled, low velocity 75mm gun effective against soft targets, but terrible against even reasonable armor.

name: Kettenkrad
help: This unarmed Kettenkrad halftrack is fast enough to provide reconnaissance, and can detect mines and enemy snipers.

name: Wirbelwind Flak Panzer
help: The Wirbelwind mounted a rapid firing 20mm flakvierling 38 on a Panzer IV chassis. Rare, but effective, this vehicle provided excellent air and ground protection for armored columns.
